cr_data.provenance: Harold Diamond, New York, NY, purchase, 1977; Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, and Elaine Horwitch Gallery, Scottsdale, Arizona, 1977 (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. This and cat. no. 196 have been associated with 1917 *Pink and Green Mountain* series O'Keeffe completed in Colorado in August 1917, see cat. nos. 218–225. Its forms, however, derive from landscape configurations in and around Palo Duro Canyon, near Canyon, Texas, where O'Keeffe lived from fall 1916 through 21 February 1918. See cat. nos. 196, 198. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

credit_line: Gift of the Family of George and Norma Kottemann
description: A watercolor painting of a mesa with horizontal bands of warm red and earthy brown near the middle. Cool blue and green washes suggest sky and foreground terrain, blending organically with soft edges and loose brushwork.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Texas Landscape)
